## Activity

During January 2024, Oakridge Primary Care recorded 95 captures. This represents the capture activity reported for the site during the month. The activity figure provides the basis for the image-quality and grading results set out below.

## Image quality

Image quality was suitable for grading in nearly all cases. There was 1 ungradable capture, giving an ungradable rate of 1.1. This result identifies the small proportion of captures that could not proceed to grading. Staff raised no new equipment faults this month.

## Grading

Grading identified 16 referable results. These results were recorded following review of the captures that could be graded. The median lag from capture to grading was 3. The median lag provides the central measure of the time taken for images to move through the grading process.

Overall, the report records the site’s activity, the number of ungradable captures, and the grading outcome for January 2024. The available results include the 95 captures, the ungradable rate of 1.1, and 16 referable results.
